title: Uruguayan Bun Empanadas
description: These tender empanadas are a classic Uruguayan dish, made with a yeasty bun and filled with a variety of ingredients, perfect for a midnight craving. They are vegetarian friendly and can be enjoyed at any time of day.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of olive oil, a few pieces of chopped onion, and a sprinkle of shredded cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of olive oil and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
